description: This Java source file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableResource' that implements the 'Resource' interface. It provides functionality for creating, managing, and serializing resource objects with specific permissions, primarily through JSON parsing and object modeling.

classes.name: ImmutableResource
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Resource interface, representing a resource with associated permissions.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a Resource instance from a ResourceKey and a JsonValue, parsing the JSON for permissions.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a Resource instance from a ResourceKey and an EffectedPermissions object.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Resource from a JsonObject, extracting resource key and permissions data.

methods.name: getResourceKey
methods.description: Returns the ResourceKey associated with this resource.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the resource type derived from the resource key.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer representing the resource's path.

methods.name: getFullQualifiedPath
methods.description: Returns a string representing the full qualified path of the resource.

methods.name: getEffectedPermissions
methods.description: Returns the EffectedPermissions associated with this resource.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the resource to JSON, considering schema version and a predicate filter.
